MySQL Community Server 8.4 LTS from Oracle's generic Linux build. Many game plugins and frameworks
(FiveM ESX/QBCore, LuckPerms, CoreProtect) are tested against MySQL rather than MariaDB.
startup: { ./mysql/bin/mysqld --defaults-file=/home/container/.my.cnf --innodb-buffer-pool-size=$(( ({{SERVER_MEMORY}} + 256) / 2 ))M & } && until ./mysql/bin/mysqladmin --defaults-extra-file=/home/container/.root.cnf ping --silent 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done && ./mysql/bin/mysql --defaults-extra-file=/home/container/.root.cnf --batch --unbuffered --table --force; wait

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MySQL 8.4 LTS install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -eo pipefail
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates xz-utils libaio1 libnuma1 libncurses6

if [ "$(uname -m)" != "x86_64" ]; then
    echo "Oracle only publishes the minimal generic build for x86_64. ARM nodes are not supported by this egg."
    exit 1
fi

CDN=https://cdn.mysql.com/Downloads/MySQL-8.4
ARCHIVE=https://downloads.mysql.com/archives/get/p/23/file

tarball_name() {
    echo "mysql-$1-linux-glibc2.28-x86_64-minimal.tar.xz"
}

if [ -z "${MYSQL_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MYSQL_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    # the CDN only keeps current releases, so the newest patch that answers is the latest one
    for patch in $(seq 40 -1 0); do
        if curl -sfI "${CDN}/$(tarball_name 8.4.${patch})" > /dev/null; then
            MYSQL_VERSION=8.4.${patch}
            break
        fi
    done
    if [ -z "${MYSQL_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MYSQL_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
        echo "Could not find a MySQL 8.4 release on ${CDN}"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

FILE=$(tarball_name "${MYSQL_VERSION}")
echo "Installing MySQL ${MYSQL_VERSION}"
cd /tmp
curl -fsSL -o mysql.tar.xz "${CDN}/${FILE}" || curl -fsSL -o mysql.tar.xz "${ARCHIVE}/${FILE}"

rm -rf /mnt/server/mysql
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mysql
tar -xJf mysql.tar.xz -C /mnt/server/mysql --strip-components=1
rm -f mysql.tar.xz
rm -rf /mnt/server/mysql/{docs,man,include}

# libaio, libnuma and libncurses are missing from the runtime image; the binaries already look in lib/private
for lib in libaio.so.1 libnuma.so.1 libncurses.so.6; do
    cp -L "/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/${lib}" /mnt/server/mysql/lib/private/
done

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/run /mnt/server/tmp
chmod 750 /mnt/server/tmp

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/.my.cnf ]; then
    cat > /mnt/server/.my.cnf <<EOF
[mysqld]
basedir = /home/container/mysql
datadir = /home/container/data
socket = /home/container/run/mysqld.sock
pid-file = /home/container/run/mysqld.pid
tmpdir = /home/container/tmp
port = ${SERVER_PORT}
bind-address = 0.0.0.0
mysqlx = OFF
skip-name-resolve
local-infile = 0
secure-file-priv = /home/container/tmp
character-set-server = utf8mb4
collation-server = utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
max_connections = 151
log-error-verbosity = 2

[client]
socket = /home/container/run/mysqld.sock
EOF
fi

if [ -d /mnt/server/data/mysql ]; then
    echo "Existing data directory found, keeping it. MySQL upgrades it on the next start."
else
    echo "Initializing a new data directory"
    INIT_CNF=/tmp/init.cnf
    sed -e 's#/home/container#/mnt/server#g' /mnt/server/.my.cnf > "${INIT_CNF}"
    /mnt/server/mysql/bin/mysqld --defaults-file="${INIT_CNF}" --user=root --initialize-insecure

    /mnt/server/mysql/bin/mysqld --defaults-file="${INIT_CNF}" --user=root --skip-networking &
    for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
        /mnt/server/mysql/bin/mysqladmin --socket=/mnt/server/run/mysqld.sock -uroot ping --silent 2>/dev/null && break
        sleep 1
    done

    {
        echo "ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '${ROOT_PASSWORD}';"
        echo "DROP USER IF EXISTS 'root'@'%';"
        if [ -n "${DB_NAME}" ]; then
            echo "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`${DB_NAME}\`;"
        fi
        if [ -n "${DB_USER}" ] && [ -n "${DB_PASSWORD}" ]; then
            echo "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '${DB_USER}'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '${DB_PASSWORD}';"
            if [ -n "${DB_NAME}" ]; then
                echo "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`${DB_NAME}\`.* TO '${DB_USER}'@'%';"
            fi
        fi
        echo "FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
    } | /mnt/server/mysql/bin/mysql --socket=/mnt/server/run/mysqld.sock -uroot

    /mnt/server/mysql/bin/mysqladmin --socket=/mnt/server/run/mysqld.sock -uroot -p"${ROOT_PASSWORD}" shutdown 2>/dev/null
    wait
    rm -f "${INIT_CNF}"
fi

# the console logs in as root through this file, so the panel console works without typing a password
cat > /mnt/server/.root.cnf <<EOF
[client]
user = root
password = "${ROOT_PASSWORD}"
socket = /home/container/run/mysqld.sock
EOF
chmod 600 /mnt/server/.root.cnf /mnt/server/.my.cnf

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "MySQL ${MYSQL_VERSION} installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.description: latest picks the newest 8.4 release, or pin one such as 8.4.13. Reinstall to upgrade; the data directory is kept.

variables.name: Root Password
variables.description: Password for root@localhost. Only used when the data directory is created; change it later with ALTER USER.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: Optional database created on first install.

variables.name: Database User
variables.description: Optional remote user (host %) created on first install with full rights on the database above.
